blocks.text: [ Principle 02 ]
Principle 2: Introducing My Family
Greeting
Now I would like to introduce my family to you.
About My Family
I have a nice family.
There are (4) people in my family including my husband, son, daughter, and me.
My family and I are close, and we enjoy spending time together.
About My Husband
My husband works at a small Cell-Phone company.
We met for the first time fifteen years ago and three years later, we got married.
He is always helpful around the house.
He often goes shopping with me and is very supportive of myself and our children in all that we do.
About My Son
My son attends 한국 Middle School, and he is a second year student.
He is good at studying all kind of subjects, but his best subject is English.
He enjoys playing sports and computer games.
He is working very hard so that he’ll be able to enter a good university after he graduates from high school.
About My Daughter
My daughter attends 한국 Elementary school.
She is in the fifth grade.
She has many talents, but she is most talented at speaking English.
Her other talents include drawing and playing the piano.
Sometimes she likes to talk to her friends on the phone.
